content:
emily: Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A: can someone put the "credits vs quotas vs reserved capacity" shortform in one place? We had multiple customers confused during demos.
harry: TL;DR we should use a single-paragraph canonical blurb: Credits = prepaid consumable units used on Hosted plans; Quotas = enforced limits (requests/min, tokens/day) applied at org/route/pool; Reserved capacity = Dedicated commitments (throughput guarantees + configurable burst windows). I'll write it up.
olivia: A few specifics that came up in Sales: 1) trial credit expiry/rollover? 2) Hosted burst behavior? 3) programmatic check for remaining balance?
harry: Answers: 1) Trial credits expire at trial end (no auto-rollover for self-serve). Enterprise deals can specify different handling. 2) Hosted allows limited short bursts when cluster headroom permits; bursts are bounded by per-tier ceilings and safety guards. If headroom isn't available we fallback to a compatible smaller model or apply rate limiting. 3) Planned public usage endpoint: `GET /v1/orgs/{org_id}/usage` (returns credit_balance, token_windows, active_rate_limits, per-route quotas).
max: For the fallback mapping, can we publish an example table? sales want concrete numbers for slides.
harry: Yes. Example (illustrative): Trial: 150k tokens/day, burst ceiling 20k tokens/1min; Growth: 500k tokens/day, burst 100k tokens/5min; Enterprise: negotiable. We'll mark numbers as subject to change.
ops-bot: infra-note: quota-alerts now fire at 75% and 95% for org token windows; dashboard panel added.
product-bot: note: created ticket PROD-9223 "docs: pricing blurb + usage API examples" assigned to harry, olivia.
emily: Perfect. Can we get a one-pager (FAQ bullets + API snippet + example numbers) for Support and Sales?
olivia: I'll draft the one-pager and link it in #docs tomorrow. Harry will review the wording.
emily: Thanks all :thumbsup:
